description:
ThreeJS Spotlight Shadow Cookie lights a marble angel with a single moving spotlight that projects a patterned texture and casts a soft, shifting shadow across the floor.

How it works. A lone spotlight sweeps a slow circle above the scene, and every frame the renderer draws the view from its position into a shadow map so the statue blocks the light realistically. The beam also carries a projected texture — a cookie (or gobo) — that…
